messages:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. We need a tight owner list + minimal ETAs for the KV-cache OOM remediation buckets: profiling, GC/compaction, eviction caps, and quick fail-safes. Can we lock this down now?

Tyler: I will own the profiling and repro work. Plan: heapshots across canary scenarios, pprof outputs, and a small repro script. ETA: Wed EOD.

Nia: I'll take compaction/GC knobs and run fragmentation vs latency benchmarks. Trying `--kv-compact-threshold=0.28` and `--compact-batch=background` first. ETA: next Tue.

Omar: I'll prototype an adaptive eviction policy that penalizes large prefixes and add a soft per-prefix cap fallback. Will measure miss-rate impact. ETA: Mon.

Luis: I can deliver a quick emergency-mode flag that makes nodes read-only when mem>90% for 60s and wire an automatic rollback guard. PR by tomorrow.

Aisha: Please include exact commands and a test plan for SRE so staging validation is straightforward.

Tyler: Sample profiling commands I'll include: `HEAPPROFILE=/tmp/heap ./kvnode --workload=canary` then `pprof --text /tmp/heap.*` and `gcore <pid>` for full dumps. Will add a small shell script.

Nia: Benchmarks will report 50/95/99 latencies, compaction pause p99, and fragmentation ratio. If compaction hurts latency, I'll try lower freq or incremental compaction.

Omar: Eviction idea: score = base_age + (size_kb/32) + write_rate_factor; evict highest score. If that regresses, fallback to strict cap per prefix.

Luis: Feature flag: `--kv-emergency-mode` with a warmup counter so we don't flip on transient spikes. Also adding metric `kv_emergency_state` for dashboards.

OpsBot: Reminder: add owners and ETAs to postmortem board. Template: owner / task / ETA / test-plan link / rollback-risk.

Aisha: Action recap (locking owners):
- Tyler: profiling + repro scripts (Wed EOD)
- Nia: GC/compaction benchmarking + proposal (Tue)
- Omar: adaptive eviction + soft-cap prototype (Mon)
- Luis: emergency-mode flag + rollback guard (PR tomorrow)
- Aisha: update board + schedule 30m sync Friday 10:30

Aisha: If anyone expects delays, update the board card and ping me. We'll validate outputs in the Friday sync.

Tyler: Uploading initial heapshots to the postmortem doc now.

Omar: Starting eviction prototype locally against Tyler's repro.

Nia: Will post benchmark harness and sample config matrix to the card.

Luis: PR opened as draft: `feat/kv-emergency-mode`
